Choose candidate operation inputs

operation_fixtures.Rd

Choose fixture values using reviewed overrides followed by schema examples, defaults, enums, and type fixtures.

Usage

operation_fixtures(operations, overrides = list())

Arguments

operations

Supported operation record or named list of records.

overrides

Reviewed per-operation fixture input values.

Value

A named list of per-operation input lists. Stops when a fixture cannot be selected or fails supported constraints.

Details

The selected value must satisfy supported type, enum, numeric, string-length, and pattern constraints. An invalid selected candidate raises an error rather than falling through to a lower-priority source. Schema examples are never executed. Candidate inputs are not independent expected request or response contracts.

See also

Step-by-step guide.

Examples

schema <- system.file('catalogue/schema.json', package = 'specmill')
operation_fixtures(read_operations(schema)$operations)
#> $get_item
#> $get_item$item_id
#> [1] "example"
#> 
#> $get_item$language
#> [1] "en"
#> 
#> 
#> $list_items
#> $list_items$page
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> 
#> $create_item
#> $create_item$body
#> $create_item$body$title
#> [1] "example"
#> 
#> $create_item$body$count
#> [1] 1
#>

#> 
#> $refresh
